questiontext.text: Which of the following are primary recognized genres and forms of drama? (Select all that apply)

generalfeedback.text: Tragedy, comedy, farce, melodrama, mime, and dance drama are all authentic dramatic genres.

questiontext.text: Which of the following are essential characteristics of a Classical Tragic Hero? (Select all that apply)

generalfeedback.text: High status, tragic flaw, and devastating downfall producing *catharsis* define the tragic hero.

generalfeedback.text: Tragedy=somber downfall; Comedy=happy humor; Farce=slapstick chaos; Mime=silent body performance.
